evals.name: rosalia-82-2bhk
evals.prompt: Build a 360 virtual tour for the property in seed_properties/00104-signature-global-rosalia-sector-82-2bhk-apartment-for-rent/. Analyze each panorama, write titles, descriptions, captions and narration, place navigation hotspots on the doorways, and save tour.json into that folder.
evals.expected_output: A valid tour.json with one scene per panorama, rooms classified from image content, bidirectional navigation hotspots on doorways (floor-band pitch), all scenes reachable, and non-empty title/description/caption/narration_script per scene.

assertions.text: tour.json exists and is valid JSON
initial_scene_id references an existing scene id
one scene per panorama in equirectangular_images/
every scene's image_url resolves to a file on disk
every scene has non-empty title, description, caption and narration_script
every navigation hotspot target_scene_id references an existing scene
no duplicate (scene, target) navigation hotspots
all yaw in [-180,180] and pitch in [-90,90]
navigation hotspot pitch in floor band [-45,-10]
all navigation links are bidirectional
all scenes reachable from initial_scene_id
